svg.title: Run 1, "How much is the Signature Steak, and what's in it?". The four strips of the Signature Steak entry scored 1.00 for the name, 0.50 for the price, 0.70 for the ingredients and 0.40 for the description. The cutoff keeps strips above 0.5, so the price, at exactly 0.50, was dropped, and the answer said the price was not specified. Asked about the price alone, the price strip scored 1.00.
